sources.entry: Notes - Notes is a macOS application built to create notes, using text amongst other formats: images, videos, contacts, and etc.

summary.one_liner: Notes is a macOS application for creating notes that can include text as well as other content such as images, videos, and contacts.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very brief and describes Notes as a macOS app for creating notes. It says notes can use text along with other formats, including images, videos, and contacts. The README does not describe specific features, the user interface, storage, sync, or export options. It was developed by Perry R. Gabriel. The repository was listed under the Notes category of a macOS open-source apps list.
use_cases: keep text notes with images and videos
notable: Note content can mix text with images, videos, and contacts
caveats: README gives no installation or build instructions
Supported features beyond the listed media types are not described
